arxiv-2012-10872.title: Robust Alignment of Multi-Exposed Images with Saturated Regions
arxiv-2012-10872.creator: Jun Jiang, Zhengguo Li, Shoulie Xie, Shiqian Wu, Liangcai Zeng
arxiv-2012-10872.description: Abstract It is challenging to align multi-exposed images due to large illumination variations, especially in presence of saturated regions. In this paper, a novel image alignment algorithm is proposed to cope with the multi-exposed images with saturated regions. Specifically, the multi-exposed images are first normalized by using intensity mapping functions (IMFs) in consideration of saturated pixels.

arxiv-2203-14230.title: DC Quantum Magnetometry Below the Ramsey Limit
arxiv-2203-14230.creator: Alexander A. Wood, Alastair Stacey, Andy M. Martin
arxiv-2203-14230.description: Abstract We demonstrate quantum sensing of dc magnetic fields that exceeds the sensitivity of conventional T 2 ∗ T_{2}^{\ast} -limited dc magnetometry by more than an order of magnitude. We used nitrogen-vacancy centers in a diamond rotating at periods comparable to the spin coherence time, and characterize the dependence of magnetic sensitivity on measurement time and rotation speed.

arxiv-2211-05354.title: Enhanced Spin-Orbit Coupling in a Correlated Metal
arxiv-2211-05354.creator: Katsunori Kubo
arxiv-2211-05354.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Katsunori Kubo. We investigate the correlation effects on spin-orbit coupling (SOC) in a two-orbital Hubbard model on a square lattice by applying the variational Monte Carlo method. We consider an effective SOC constant λ eff \lambda_{\text{eff}} in the one-body part of the variational wave function and mainly discuss the cases of the electron number per site n = 1 n=1 , that is, quarter filling.

arxiv-2308-11644.title: Synergistic Signal Denoising for Multimodal Time Series of Structure Vibration
arxiv-2308-11644.creator: Yang Yu, Han Chen
arxiv-2308-11644.description: Abstract Structural Health Monitoring (SHM) plays an indispensable role in ensuring the longevity and safety of infrastructure. With the rapid growth of sensor technology, the volume of data generated from various structures has seen an unprecedented surge, bringing forth challenges in efficient analysis and interpretation.

arxiv-2312-12033.title: Emergence of a potential charge disproportionated insulating state in SrCrO 3
arxiv-2312-12033.creator: Alberto Carta, Anwesha Panda, Claude Ederer
arxiv-2312-12033.description: Abstract We use a combination of density functional theory (DFT) and dynamical mean-field theory (DMFT) to investigate the potential emergence of a charge-disproportionated insulating phase in SrCrO 3 , whereby the Cr cations disproportionate according to 3 ​ Cr 4 + → 2 ​ Cr 3 + + Cr 6 + 3\text{Cr}^{4+}\rightarrow 2\text{Cr}^{3+}+\text{Cr}^{6+} and arrange in ordered planes perpendicular to

arxiv-2402-01969.title: Simulation-Enhanced Data Augmentation for Machine Learning Pathloss Prediction This work is supported by the National Science Foundation under grants EEC-1941529, CNS-2212565, and CNS-2225578. (Ahmed P. Mohamed and Byunghyun Lee contributed equally to this work.)
arxiv-2402-01969.creator: Ahmed P. Mohamed 1 , Byunghyun Lee 1 , Yaguang Zhang 1 , Max Hollingsworth 2 , C. Robert Anderson 3 , James V. Krogmeier 1 , David J. Love 1
arxiv-2402-01969.description: Abstract Machine learning (ML) offers a promising solution to pathloss prediction. However, its effectiveness can be degraded by the limited availability of data. To alleviate these challenges, this paper introduces a novel simulation-enhanced data augmentation method for machine learning (ML) pathloss prediction. Our method integrates synthetic data generated from a cellular coverage simulator and independently collected real-world datasets.

arxiv-2403-11033.title: Stellarator Optimization with Constraints
arxiv-2403-11033.creator: Rory Conlin \aff 1 \corresp, Patrick Kim \aff 2, Daniel W. Dudt \aff 1, Dario Panici \aff 1, Egemen Kolemen \aff 1 \corresp
arxiv-2403-11033.description: Abstract In this work we consider the problem of optimizing a stellarator subject to hard constraints on the design variables and physics properties of the equilibrium. We survey current numerical methods for handling these constraints, and summarize a number of methods from the wider optimization community that have not been used extensively for stellarator optimization thus far.

arxiv-2403-19554.title: Cross-Attention is Not Always Needed: Dynamic Cross-Attention for Audio-Visual Dimensional Emotion Recognition
arxiv-2403-19554.creator: R. Gnana Praveen, Jahangir Alam
arxiv-2403-19554.description: Abstract In video-based emotion recognition, audio and visual modalities are often expected to have a complementary relationship, which is widely explored using cross-attention. However, they may also exhibit weak complementary relationships, resulting in poor representations of audio-visual features, thus degrading the performance of the system.

arxiv-2508-03494.title: Prototype-Enhanced Confidence Modeling for Cross-Modal Medical Image-Report Retrieval
arxiv-2508-03494.creator: Shreyank N Gowda, Xiaobo Jin, Christian Wagner
arxiv-2508-03494.description: Abstract In cross-modal retrieval tasks, such as image-to-report and report-to-image retrieval, accurately aligning medical images with relevant text reports is essential but challenging due to the inherent ambiguity and variability in medical data. Existing models often struggle to capture the nuanced, multi-level semantic relationships in radiology data, leading to unreliable retrieval results.

arxiv-2511-10144.title: The maximum diameter of 2 2 -dimensional simplicial complexes
arxiv-2511-10144.creator: Olaf Parczyk, Silas Rathke, Tibor Szabó
arxiv-2511-10144.description: Abstract We study a problem of Santos about the largest possible diameter of a d d -dimensional (abstract) simplicial complex on n n vertices. For dimension 2 2 , we determine the exact value of the maximum for every n n using an explicit construction.

pmc-10594243.title: Healthcare-associated Stenotrophomonas maltophilia infections in the United States, 2018–2022
pmc-10594243.creator: Amelia Keaton, Lucy Fike, Kevin Spicer, Alexander Kallen, Kiran Perkins
pmc-10594243.description: Background: Stenotrophomonas maltophilia is an important cause of opportunistic healthcare-associated infections (HAIs) in critically ill patients and is difficult to treat due to intrinsic resistance to multiple antibiotic classes. During the COVID-19 pandemic, the CDC received anecdotal reports of increases in S. maltophilia respiratory infections.

pmc-11334804.title: Predicting progression-free survival in patients with epithelial ovarian cancer using an interpretable random forest model
pmc-11334804.creator: Lian Jian, Xiaoyan Chen, Pingsheng Hu, Handong Li, Chao Fang, Jing Wang, Nayiyuan Wu, Xiaoping Yu
pmc-11334804.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Prognostic models play a crucial role in providing personalised risk assessment, guiding treatment decisions, and facilitating the counselling of patients with cancer. However, previous imaging-based artificial intelligence models of epithelial ovarian cancer lacked interpretability. In this study, we aimed to develop an interpretable machine-learning model to predict progression-free survival in patients with epithelial ovarian cancer using clinical variables and radiomics features. A total of 102 patients with epithelial ovarian cancer who underwent contrast-enhanced computed tomography scans were enrolled in this retrospective study.

pmc-12467293.title: Evaluation of Irisin and Interleukin-6 Levels in Saliva Samples of Periodontally Healthy and Stage 3 Grade C Periodontitis Individuals
pmc-12467293.creator: Ebru Saribas, Müzeyyen Kandemir, Revsa Evin Canpolat Erkan, Mehmet Cudi Tuncer, Antonino Maniaci, Caterina Gagliano, Giovanni Giurdanella, Mohamed Amin Zaoual
pmc-12467293.description: Simple SummaryPeriodontitis is a common gum disease that can cause serious damage to the tissues supporting the teeth and may even affect general health through inflammation. Early detection and monitoring of this disease are important for preventing tooth loss and other complications. In this study, we investigated two molecules called interleukin-6 and irisin, which can be measured in saliva.

pmc-12827936.title: Location and capacity optimization of urban sanitation robot base stations using improved NSGA-II
pmc-12827936.creator: Jie Ding, Linshen Wang, Kun Pan, Nan Ji, Na Cui
pmc-12827936.description: Traditional sanitation systems are increasingly challenged by contemporary waste collection demands, owing to limited service capacity, high operational costs, and uneven resource distribution. Sanitation robots, capable of high-precision waste identification and multi-robot collaboration, offer a promising alternative to improve collection efficiency. Their performance, however, critically depends on the scientific layout of base stations.

pmc-13237660.title: Transition metal-induced excess electron localization driving the giant first hyperpolarizability in alkaline earthides: a DFT and TD-DFT study
pmc-13237660.creator: Jabir Hussain, Riaz Hussain, Dua Tahreem, Annum Ahsan, Muhammad Arshad, Khurshid Ayub
pmc-13237660.description: The rational design of alkaline earthides with high stability and superior nonlinear (NLO) response remains a significant challenge. In this work, 3d transition metals (V–Zn) are used for the first time as donors of excess electrons to develop a series of earthides, i.e., M+(36adz)Ca− (M+ = V–Zn), using 36adz as the complexant.

pmc-13278878.title: Investigating the relationship between social media exposure, body image dissatisfaction, and self-compassion in adolescent athlete
pmc-13278878.creator: Jie Chen, Tao Tao
pmc-13278878.description: IntroductionSocial media exposure has become a significant influence on adolescents’ body image perceptions, particularly among adolescent athletes who face both performance-related and appearance-related pressures. This study investigated the relationship between social media exposure and body image dissatisfaction, focusing on the mediating role of self-compassion and the moderating role of fear of negative evaluation.

pmc-13291246.title: A retrospective cross-sectional study on newborn screening and prevalence of disorders among UAE population
pmc-13291246.creator: Khadija Shafique, Afsheen Raza, Ariba Naushad, Fathima Hussain, Duaa Walid, Laila Wareth, Ayman W. El-Hattab, Rania Nabil Bedair, Rania Al Dweik, Najwane Said Sadier

pmc-13545581.title: Seven-year sonographic evolution from a simple vaginal wall cyst to hepatoid adenocarcinoma of the urethrovaginal septum
pmc-13545581.creator: Quanlin Ren, Tian Tian, Jinzhou Wan
pmc-13545581.description: ry involvement of the urethrovaginal septum has rarely been described (2). We report a case in which ultrasound documented the seven-year transformation of an apparently benign cystic lesion in the urethrovaginal septum into an AFP-secreting HAC, illustrating the diagnostic value of long-term serial sonographic surveillance. Case presentation A 48-year-old woman presented with a three-week history of hematuria.

pmc-13587073.creator: Jiayan Ding, Darryl Chin, Ellie Choi, Valencia Long

pmc-13619840.title: PD-1 deficiency reshapes the TCRβ repertoire and T-cell developmental programs associated with susceptibility to lupus-like autoimmunity
pmc-13619840.creator: Xianliang Hou, Zhenyu Liu, Guiya Lu, Shaofeng Jiang, Jinjun Qiu, Chunhong Li, Meng Meng, Zipeng Hu, Yinping Lei, Huilin Lao, Lemin Chen, Yue Wen, Siyan Xie, Yuqiang Liang
pmc-13619840.description: IntroductionProgrammed cell death protein-1 (PD-1) functions as a pivotal immune checkpoint, essential for maintaining peripheral immune tolerance, and serves as a significant therapeutic target in cancer immunotherapy. Nevertheless, the relationship between PD-1 deficiency and baseline alterations in T-cell receptor (TCR) repertoire organization, as well as the susceptibility to lupus-like autoimmunity, remains inadequately elucidated.
